description: This file defines a REST API controller class 'SystemCheckAPI' used in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It handles GET requests to perform system checks by invoking methods from the SystemCheck utility class, and returns the results in a JSON-like array structure.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that handles system check requests for the installer/upgrader component of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles the GET request by performing system checks and returning the results and statuses.
